Dearest Richa,

There are things in this world that bloom without asking for permission — not for applause, not for an audience — simply because it is their nature to be beautiful.

You are like that.

In a world that moves too fast and forgets too easily, you are the kind of person who makes it worth pausing. Worth noticing. Worth being entirely present for.

Twenty-three years of you. Of your laughter that feels like sunlight through petals. Of your spirit, warm and quietly radiant — the kind that fills every room before you even say a word.

On this day, and every day that follows, I want you to know — you deserve every lily, every orchid, every tulip and every rose the world has to offer. You deserve every good thing. All of it. Completely. Without question.

May this year bring you everything your heart quietly holds.

with all the stars above 🌸
